worlds.note: Seven colour worlds share the token slots, set with :root[data-theme=<id>]. Dusk is the default; Bone & Sepia is the light world (default when the OS prefers light) and also overrides the element and keep/trash colours.

narrative.overview:
Ghost is a Ghost shell throwing Destiny's Light across a dark vault. The screen reads as a projected dossier: ruled sheets on a dusk ground, Cinzel inscriptions carved across the top of each view, and thin warm light that picks out whatever matters. The Light has two jobs and only two: it marks what the user is touching (hover, focus, the active nav row) and it marks *why* something matched (each search pane owns a colour, and every field, perk cell and icon it hit glows in that colour). Everything else stays quiet, dim and square.

The world is dense but legible. Desktop is the Vanguard Dossier: a 232px left rail, a scene header where relevant Bungie art sits behind the title band only, and search panes laid side by side as ruled sheets. Phone is Leaded Light: one pane per screen, items as framed cards whose perks sit in leaded-glass cells, bottom tabs, a bottom-sheet item panel. Seven colour worlds share one structure; Dusk is the default, Bone & Sepia is the light world.

It refuses the generic dark-blue dashboard: no rounded card grids, no blue-grey chrome, no gradient KPI tiles. Depth comes from light and hairlines, not from lifted boxes.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners everywhere except round perk icons and theme orbs.
Hairline rules (1px) separate everything; sheets carry a 2px top rule in their pane colour.
Cinzel uppercase inscriptions for view titles, pane titles and section heads; Hanken Grotesk for all working UI.
Search matches glow in their pane's colour; the item's element lights its row edge.
Art lives behind titles, never behind data.
Motion is projection: things open from a line of light and titles are written in light; all of it switches off together.

rules.name: The Light Means Attention Rule
rules.body: Peach Light marks only what the user is pointing at, what is active, or progress. Never use it as a fill or as decoration.

rules.name: The Matched Colour Rule
rules.body: A pane colour appears only where that pane's search matched, plus the pane's own top rule and chip. If a highlight cannot say which search lit it, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Six Worlds Rule
rules.body: Every surface uses theme tokens (`--bg`, `--panel`, `--line`, `--light`, `--accent`...), never literal hexes, so all six worlds (and the Bone & Sepia light world, which also darkens the element and keep/trash colours) work unchanged.

rules.name: The Inscription Rule
rules.body: Cinzel is only ever uppercase, tracked at 0.1em or more, and only for titles and section heads. Never set body, buttons or numbers in Cinzel.

rules.name: The Light Weight Rule
rules.body: Large Hanken text (20px and up) is weight 300; weight comes from size, not boldness.

rules.name: The Art Behind Titles Rule
rules.body: Bungie art appears only in scene headers, bands, the subclass head and the item panel hero, always under a scrim that fades to the ground from the left and bottom. It never sits behind lists, tables or controls.

rules.name: The Lit Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces never cast drop shadows. Emphasis is an inset glow or a coloured hairline; only modals and toasts float.

dos: **Do** use theme tokens for every surface and text colour so all six worlds work, including Bone & Sepia.
**Do** light a search match in that pane's colour, on the exact field, perk or icon it matched.
**Do** keep every container square and separate with 1px hairlines.
**Do** set titles and section heads in uppercase Cinzel tracked 0.1em to 0.24em; everything else in Hanken Grotesk.
**Do** put Bungie art only behind title bands and the item hero, under a scrim to the ground colour, and credit it.
**Do** use the authored line-icon set (24px viewBox, 1.6 stroke, round caps) and Bungie or sprite icons for game objects.
**Do** route all motion through the shared easing (`cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`) and make it stop under `prefers-reduced-motion` and the in-app Motion toggle.
donts: **Don't** build the generic dark-blue dashboard: no rounded card grids, blue-grey chrome or gradient metric tiles.
**Don't** round containers or controls; roundness belongs to perk icons and theme orbs only.
**Don't** put art or imagery behind lists, tables or controls.
**Don't** use Peach Light or pane colours as decoration or large fills.
**Don't** cast drop shadows from resting surfaces.
**Don't** set body text, buttons or numbers in Cinzel.
**Don't** use text glyphs or emoji as icons, and don't copy Bungie's UI glyphs; chrome is original SVG.
**Don't** add small uppercase kicker labels above titles; the inscription title stands alone.
